units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 5:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. V, 1</cite> (ref. to <he>הנחילות</he> <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 5:4">ib.</cite>) <he>על שתי הנ׳ שנחל דוד וכ׳</he> ed. Bub. (oth. ed. <cite ref="U01585"><he>שני</he></cite>, corr. acc.) for the two inheritances, because David inherited royalty &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 629:2">Yalk. ib. 629</cite> <he>על שני נַחֲלוֹת</he>. Midr. Till. l. c. <he>בשתי נ׳ נחלנו וכ׳</he> two inheritances: we inherited thee and inherited the Torah.
